names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/9997.html` link carries in its `title`, «Михаил (Вознесенский), мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off; the surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays. The day's line names him last and alone of the fourteen with a rank of his own, «и мч. Михаила», which is why this folder carries `martyr` and no clerical type and no `office`. The same day keeps a priest «Матфий (Вознесенский)» of 1919 in a separate entry; the surname is shared and nothing read links the two men. `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст., which is the year for all fourteen people that line names. His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Антония , еп. Белгородского, и с ним Митрофана , Александра , Михаила , Ипполита , Николая , Василия , Николая , Максима , Александра , Павла , Павла , Георгия пресвитеров и мч. Михаила (1938).»

attestations.note: Last of the thirteen named «и с ним» after the bishop of Belgorod, and **the only layman of the fourteen**: the line's «пресвитеров» closes before him and he is introduced separately as «и мч. Михаила», which his name page repeats, «Михаил (Вознесенский), мч.» So this folder carries `martyr` alone, no clerical type and no `office`. He is also the second Michael of the line — the first stands inside the run of presbyters, name link 9682 — and the two are told apart by the links and by the grade. **The line and the name link are all there is**: 9997 is a heading, the grade and two days, with no narrative. azbyka.ru was not read.
